attempts.summary: Configured node1 (SONiC) as router between node2 and node3, addressed the two transit links (eth1/192.168.1.1 to node2, eth2/192.168.2.1 to node3), enabled L3 forwarding, and installed an nftables forward-chain ACL that allows TCP 8080 and rejects (TCP reset) TCP 23 between the two links while leaving all other forwarded traffic (default-accept) untouched. Configuration was persisted (sysctl.d, ifupdown fragments on node2/node3, a systemd oneshot + /etc/antrieb-acl.nft on node1) and verified to survive a one-at-a-time restart of all three nodes with changed boot IDs and full functional recovery.
